purpose: Ingest sparse-state discoveries spanning lightweight remote-sensing AI, taxonomy/provenance, chromatography troubleshooting, inductive-loop lifecycle engineering, labor-market data and environmental modeling.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Repository mirrors, standards resellers, NVD reference aliases and publisher/index copies for the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Repository IDs, taxonomy IDs, support-article IDs, standards numbers, dataset IDs, DOI components and legacy security IDs can be useful to Worldshepherd but have zero automatic Glob evidence.

sources.title: Lightweight remote sensing image detection algorithm based on YOLO11
sources.authority: Lancashire Online Knowledge / published article record
sources.note: Use parameter/computation reduction plus multiscale fusion and loss-function benchmarking as a compact edge-vision validation case. 59677 is the repository record ID.

sources.title: Schima superba taxonomy record
sources.note: Use stable namespace identity, lineage and cross-resource link structure as a provenance-schema precedent. 59677 is a taxonomy identifier.

sources.title: APC ISM pressure fluctuation
sources.note: Use symptom-environment-cause-fix structure and air-ingress/loose-fitting diagnosis as an equipment troubleshooting template. 59677 is a support article ID.

sources.title: IEC TR 63079 — Code of practice for hearing-loop systems
sources.authority: IEC technical report / current national adoptions
sources.note: Use design, planning, installation, magnetic-field testing, operation and maintenance guidance as a lifecycle reference for inductive communication/field systems. 63079 is the publication number.

sources.title: Contract type — labor-market salary statistics
sources.authority: Spain datos.gob.es / Instituto Nacional de Estadistica
sources.note: Use multi-format public-statistics delivery (CSV/XLSX/JSON) as an ingestion/interoperability test corpus and workforce-analysis reference. 70593 is the dataset ID.

sources.title: Campylobacter infections expected to increase due to climate change in Northern Europe
sources.note: Use as an environmental exposure/outcome modeling precedent with multi-country climate and public-health data. 70593 is a DOI component.

information_updates.finding: The Waters support record uses a compact symptom -> environment -> cause -> fix -> additional-information structure that can be generalized into Worldshepherd maintenance incident records and automated diagnostic playbooks.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Template transfer only; no claim that Worldshepherd uses the cited chromatography instrument.

information_updates.finding: IEC TR 63079 treats magnetic-induction communication systems as a complete lifecycle problem spanning design, planning, installation, testing, operation and maintenance. This is directly useful as a checklist model for Worldshepherd RF/EM prototypes that otherwise risk overemphasizing initial field performance.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Method/lifecycle reuse only; no compliance claim is made.

information_updates.finding: The 2026 YOLO11 study provides an explicit efficiency-versus-accuracy evaluation pattern for edge vision: parameter count, computational cost and multiple mAP thresholds are reported together across primary and generalized remote-sensing datasets.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Use as a benchmarking pattern; reported detector gains require independent reproduction before local adoption.

next_actions: Continue analyzer-driven sparse-state multiplicity scans until single-record/single-namespace states materially decline.
Convert useful troubleshooting/lifecycle patterns into candidate Worldshepherd schemas/checklists without claiming standards compliance or direct equipment applicability.
Continue repository/runtime cross-checks before converting generic software-security lessons into concrete remediation tasks.
Continue same-system physical topology and relational verification with fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls.
